macros.name: CaptionBoxWidth
macros.doc: \CaptionBoxWidth is the calculated width of the caption box for the current figure, taking into account the dead margin as well as the min/max allowed caption widths.

macros.name: CaptionFontSize
macros.doc: \CaptionFontSize defines the default size of the caption font, for example , \large, \scriptsize, etc. The default value is \small.

macros.name: captionGap
macros.doc: \captionGap defines the horizontal space between the caption identifier (e.g., “Figure 1.”) and the start of the caption text itself.

macros.name: CaptionJustification
macros.doc: The flushing of the actual text within the caption box may be accomplished by setting \CaptionJustification.

macros.name: captionStyle
macros.doc: \captionStyle{offset type}{alignment type} is a compact way of specifying the caption style.

macros.name: clearFigures
macros.doc: \clearTables and \clearFigures directs that any tables or figures that have been stored, but not yet printed, be output at this point.

macros.name: clearlistoffigures
macros.doc: \clearlistoftables and \clearlistoffigures clear the cited list (i.e., those lists currently “on hold”).

macros.name: constrainCaptionWidth
macros.doc: The minimum and maximum allowed caption widths may be simultaneously specified with \constrainCaptionWidth.

macros.name: DeadMargin
macros.doc: \DeadMargin is the low-level variable where the dead margin of the current figure or table box is specified by the advanced user.

macros.name: FigureDeadMargin
macros.doc: \TableDeadMargin and \FigureDeadMargin may be set to correct the caption alignment for boxes that have a deadzone around their border.

macros.name: holdlistoffigures
macros.doc: \holdlistoftables and \holdlistoffigures direct that calls to print the particular list cited be deferred until a later invocation of the corresponding \clear... command.

macros.name: holdlistoftables
macros.doc: \holdlistoftables and \holdlistoffigures direct that calls to print the particular list cited be deferred until a later invocation of the corresponding \clear... command.

macros.name: holdTables
macros.doc: \holdTables and \holdFigures are used to direct that any subsequent invocations of \bxtable and \bxfigure merely store, rather than store & print the table or figure.

macros.name: killlistoffigures
macros.doc: \killlistoftables, \killlistoffigures and \killtableofcontents direct that any subsequent calls to print the respective list be ignored and that the list be discarded.

macros.name: relaxCaptionWidth
macros.doc: The routine \relaxCaptionWidth takes as its optional argument a length dimension corresponding to the minimum allowed caption width, even if an associated table or figure is of lesser box width.

macros.name: SaveCBox
macros.doc: The low-level routine which saves a “captioned box” is called \SaveCBox. As its arguments, it follows the form of the LaTeX \sbox command: it takes a new command name and the boxed object as its parameters.

macros.name: StoreFigure
macros.doc: The saved information resulting from a \StoreTable or \StoreFigure command will consist of a pointer to a saved box, a pointer to the caption text, a pointer to the calculated width of the caption box (based on the state of the boxhandler parameters at the time of the function call), and pointers to the wrapper and a flag indicating whether wrappers are active for this figure or table.

macros.name: TableFontSize
macros.doc: \TableFontSize defines the default size of the font that appears within the tables themselves.

macros.name: theClearedFigure
macros.doc: The format for presenting tables and figures to be cleared (i.e., one table/figure per page, vertically centered) can be changed by renewing the commands \theClearedTable and/or \theClearedFigure.

macros.name: theClearedFigure
macros.doc: The format for presenting tables and figures to be cleared (i.e., one table/figure per page, vertically centered) can be changed by renewing the commands \theClearedTable and/or \theClearedFigure.

macros.name: theClearedTable
macros.doc: Quite simply, this routine prints out each table to be cleared, one per page, vertically centered.

macros.name: WrapperOff
macros.doc: Wrappers can be turned off with \WrapperOff.

macros.name: WrapperOn
macros.doc: Initially disabled, \WrapperOn turns wrappers on.

macros.name: WrapperTextStyle
